en: See, I take what the peddlers bring to sell,
stock them, and sell them on. So, naturally,
I can't restock unless a peddler comes by.
You really aren't going to buy anything?
Hmm, in that case, I'll take this comb.
Really? Well, aren't you a fine man!
Say, um, what was your name again?
Thank you kindly.
Come back and buy as much as you like.
and my husband Lehn runs the inn.
What sort of things do you have here?
Everything, if it's something you'd need.
Best to just buy things like these, right?
You may not need them right now,
but if you need anything, come on over.
Don't you ever write love letters?
Look, wouldn't this paper do nicely?
Why not buy some for the young ladies?
Let me see... I think I'll buy this comb.
Really? You'll make a fine man one day.
I'll remember that, you know.
Luisa,
there's something I want.
But your shop doesn't sell it.
It's something you have,
something that only you have...
W-what is it?
Don't make me wait. Out with it.
It's your blood.
What are you doing...
And I need your cooperation.
I'm sorry to ask such an unreasonable thing.
This manor was the villa of a noble who held
note: 'villa' clause moved to nothing in #2513: English word order; sentence completes across #2512+#2513

en: many estates in this country.
That noble was our ancestor,
the head of the Vampir clan...
So, as for our living here,
there's no problem at all.
I've told the villagers that we are
distant relatives of that noble,
so please go along with that.
First, go and have a look around the village.
By day you look every inch human, so
there's nothing to worry about.
Night. Now is when you, as a Vampir,
can bring your powers to bear.
Visit their homes and drink their blood.
By drinking from a human several times,
you can make that person your "servant."
A human you make a servant is a "Nosferatu,"
and an enemy's servant is a "Dhampir."
Remember that, all right?
To drink blood, you need Blood Flow...
in other words, blood to share with them.
Your Blood Flow drops every time you drink,
so you can't drink from dozens a night.
Set your sights on a human who's worth it
and drink from them. That's more efficient.
But if the enemy drinks from them too,
they're less likely to become a Nosferatu,
so be careful.
Stamina and Blood Flow recover by morning,
so don't hesitate to drink.
To make a Nosferatu by drinking at night,
visit that resident by day as often as you can
and get close to them.
The more they open up to you, the more
effectively you can drink.
Conversely, drinking from a stranger
will hardly change anything.
If a resident goes out somewhere by day,
try finding out where.
Visit every day and they'll gradually relax
and become friendly.
, for now I'll call the Nosferatu you
note: follows {PLAYER_NAME}; verb 'call' moved here, #2556 is just the term

en: drink from yourself
"direct Nosferatu."
A direct Nosferatu can then
drink from the residents around them
and recruit more comrades.
